tex_content.html:
\begin{claim} \end{claim}[Curvature bound along the standard flow] ↗ def:standard-ricci-flow

For $t_0<T$, $t_0<C^{-1}$, and $0\le t\le t_0$, \[ R(x,t)\le \frac C{1-Ct}. \] \end{claim}
Proof

↗ prop:standard-flow-asymptotic-cylinder \sketch At infinity $R<2/(1-t)$. On the compact set where a maximum can exceed this value, $\partial _tR\le R^2$; comparison with $C/(1-Ct)$ proves the claim.

□
